editorial:
Imagine heading out for a fun boat trip with your three best friends, only to have everything go wrong. You start off feeling relaxed and happy, but the mood shifts quickly when you realize you are stuck in the middle of the ocean with no way home. The vibe is tense from the start, making you feel the panic as the group starts to argue and fight. You will feel like you are right there on the deck with them, wondering who is going to crack first as the situation gets worse and worse.

What really works here is how the tension builds up between the friends. The acting feels real, and the scary moments hit hard because you care about the characters. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the twists keep you guessing until the end. If you love survival stories, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you want the best picture possible, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go. It looks great in high definition.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking twist where you find out that not everyone was a friend. One person had a secret plan to get rid of the others for money. After a brutal fight for survival, only one person makes it off the boat alive. They are rescued by a passing ship, but they have to live with the guilt and the trauma of what happened to their friends in the open sea.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers and stories about friendship gone wrong.
